t.zh: 「刮风 ∧ ¬¬下雨」里的 ¬¬下雨 换成下雨，在证明板上要先拆开外面的「并且」，换掉里面那一句，再拼回去。
t.en: To turn the ¬¬it rains in “it is windy ∧ ¬¬it rains” into it rains, the proof board must take the outer “and” apart, replace the part inside, and put it back together.

t.zh: 两句话等价，句子里出现一句的地方就能直接换成另一句。这样用的等价式叫<wiki-ref to="rewrite"></wiki-ref>，新元件<part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref>按一条改写规则在目标里换一处。
t.en: Where two sentences are equivalent, one can be swapped for the other right inside a sentence. An equivalence used this way is a <wiki-ref to="rewrite"></wiki-ref>; the new part <part-ref to="part:rw"></part-ref> uses one to change one place in the goal.

after.en: This is the basic move of a <wiki-ref to="simplifier"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，去掉每个目标里的 ¬¬。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that takes the ¬¬ out of each goal.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:dneg"></part-ref>的两个形状都可以当改写规则。
hint.en: Both shapes of <part-ref to="lemma:dneg"></part-ref> can serve as rewrite rules.
